question: According to the Census of India 2011, which State/Union Territory has the lowest sex ratio?
solution:
**The correct answer is 'Daman and Diu'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sex Ratio:**

 
 
• The sex ratio is the number of females per 1000 males in a population. It is an important indicator of gender balance in a region.
 
• The Census of India 2011 provides data on sex ratios for various states and union territories.
 
 
 
• **Daman and Diu:**
 
 
• Daman and Diu had the lowest sex ratio among Union Territories according to the 2011 Census.
 
• The sex ratio in Daman and Diu was 618 females per 1000 males.
 
 
 
• **Haryana:**
 
 
• Haryana had the lowest sex ratio among the states in India according to the 2011 Census.
 
• The sex ratio in Haryana was 879 females per 1000 males.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Punjab:**

 
 
• Punjab had a sex ratio of 895 females per 1000 males according to the 2011 Census.
 
• While the sex ratio in Punjab is low, it is not as low as in Haryana or Daman and Diu.
 
 
 
• **Lakshadweep:**
 
 
• Lakshadweep had a relatively balanced sex ratio of 946 females per 1000 males according to the 2011 Census.
 
• It is one of the union territories with a better gender balance compared to others.
